record.who: New LLC buyers choosing a paid package; the Basic package is still $0 plus state filing fees.
record.read: Prices hold while the top package drops done-for-you tax prep and gains attorney consultations, bookkeeping tools and a cheaper renewal. This reads as a repositioning from an accountant bundle to an attorney-led one.
record.caveat: Premium also adds a 6-month bookkeeping subscription that renews at $9.99/mo; we did not weigh that against the lost tax prep.
